direction_notes: At 850 kPa targeting the thalamus/hypothalamus (Location I), FUS decreased heart rate and increased respiratory rate; the same pressure targeting a distant motor-related region (Location II) instead increased heart rate. 425 kPa at Location I produced small, non-significant changes relative to sham.
safety_notes: No evidence of cell damage was found within or adjacent to the FUS focus in any of the three mice used for histology.

flags.reason: A 'sham condition' is referenced in the results/figures (e.g., 'In the sham condition, changes in cardiac and respiratory rate...') but its mechanism is not described in the Methods.

Only 850 kPa (with its associated derated values) is explicitly restated for Location II; the same derating/intensity figures given for Location I are assumed to apply since the paper does not repeat separate derated values for Location II.

The 425 kPa entry's intensity unit in the source text is garbled ('2.5 W=cm2 I') without an explicit ISPPA subscript, unlike the 850 kPa entry which explicitly states I_SPPA; both are recorded as ISPPA by parallel structure.

The paper states data was 'processed blindly' (blinded analysis of cardiac/respiratory extraction), which is recorded as single blinding; this does not necessarily reflect blinding of stimulus delivery.
